Name: Shie-Esque Aspen Portraits
Author: Stephamoeba
Description:
A portrait mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6754]invatorzen's Aspen NPC mod[/url]﻿.This mod covers all of Aspen's alternate portraits included in the original mod.

This imitates the art style of Shielia from their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]SHIE'S PORTRAITS﻿﻿[/url]﻿, so please be sure to support their work!
If you are looking for a Content Patcher forms of Shie's portraits...[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8361]Shie's Portraits for Content Patcher by leifcg﻿﻿[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9635]﻿Shie's Portraits for SVE Content Patcher by AlmostMidnight﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]
MOD REQUIREMENTS:[list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
[*]PyTK (Platonymous Toolkit)
[*]SHIE'S PORTRAITS
[*]Aspen - New Custom Dateable NPC (EN PT-BR RU ES)
[/list]

INSTALLATION GUIDE:
Simply download the zip folder, unzip it, and place the unzipped folder within your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
(Example: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)

Downloads.Description: Download and place inside your Stardew Valley Mods folder
